verdict.rationale: Mercury states directly that users can email or upload receipts and it will auto-attach them to the right card transaction (mercury-docs-5, mercury-docs-28). Programmatic receipt upload is also supported through the API's transaction-attachment endpoint, documented write actions, and an official receipt-upload agent skill (mercury-docs-12, mercury-docs-29, mercury-supp-agent-skills). The email/upload claim comes only from marketing copy, so missing for 10: in-depth docs on the email-in address and matching logic (including non-card transactions or failed matches), and independent hands-on corroboration that auto-matching works.
